== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Carturus is a frozen ocean planet characterized by a thick outer layer of ice. The world is inhabited by a [[World Spirit]] who maintains a protective agreement with [[the Advocates]]; in exchange for periodic offerings of treasure, the [[spirit]] ensures the safety of those held in [[Advocate]] custody. The planet serves as a prison site for [[the Advocates]] and contains several facilities on its surface, including fish hatcheries and [[Aethertech]] laboratories. While located within the territory of the [[Free Worlds]], it is situated in [[Advocate space]]. The planet was also the site of a significant event known as the Carturus incident, which left an individual in critical condition.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Carturus is a frozen ocean planet characterized by a thick layer of ice and serves as a prison for [[the Advocates]]. After [[Doctor Nova]] was taken to this world, it became a destination on the flight path for the crew of [[The Last Horizon]]. Although the team is traveling toward the system, they are not yet close to the location and must attempt to determine if they have entered teleporter range. While the [[lightning rabbit]] is not native to this environment, a battle involving [[Starhammer]] eventually takes place on the planet's surface.}}
